task: Take the BOX_MIDDLE of the box and place it on INSPECTION_TABLE. After that, the stack should look like it is removed the middle box ONLY. NOTE: only the top box of the box stack can be picked(like the data structure).
plan_summary: To remove only the middle box from a stack (where only the top box can be picked), we must: (1) pick BOX_TOP and temporarily place it on TEMP_TABLE, (2) pick BOX_MIDDLE and place it on INSPECTION_TABLE, (3) pick BOX_TOP back from TEMP_TABLE and place it on BOX_BOTTOM, restoring the stack minus the middle layer.
assumptions: BOX_TOP is currently at the top of the box stack and can be picked first
After BOX_TOP is removed, BOX_MIDDLE becomes the new top of the stack and can be picked
TEMP_TABLE is available as a temporary holding location for BOX_TOP during the operation
After placing BOX_TOP on BOX_BOTTOM, the resulting stack (BOX_BOTTOM → BOX_TOP) represents the original stack with only the middle removed
